coverage_notes: Catalogue size is independent of the locally retrieved meshes.
Orientation counts come from Objaverse alignment validation and Omni6DPose mesh/alignment reports. Other datasets have no consolidated orientation report in this export.
Render counts use exact source-category matches in validated Objaverse and Omni6DPose reports. Unmatched or incompatible counts are null, not zero.
ShapeNet merged render totals include overlapping category batches and are excluded from per-category counts.
Stage illumination encodes category-level reported counts; point positions are schematic and do not identify individual source IDs.

Drive aligned_all and renders_all contain batch archives; the Objaverse progress workbook independently agrees on 434 categories and 44,473 catalogue entries. The workbook processed column is a separate partial progress measure (4,216), not the alignment count.
